assets.generationPrompt: Use case photorealistic-natural. ONE realistic photographed production-ready transparent PNG asset for Alien: Covenant (2017). Exact film costume construction and materials, no generic sci-fi armor. True alpha-zero background and wide clean transparent padding on all sides, no grey/black/white backdrop, no matte glow, no checkerboard, no floor or shadow, no text or display label, no weapons or extra objects. Four references: 1 official Origins cover showing Daniels in silver flexible suit; 2 actual fitting photograph of Katherine Waterston wearing the round black helmet; 3 screen-used Tennessee silver soft suit displayed at Propstore, shows full standardized suit engineering including lower legs and boots; 4 unrelated David sprite IGNORE for all suit assets. The standard suit is SILVER-GREY FLEXIBLE TEXTURED FABRIC with olive harness and compact fittings, not the yellow rigid maintenance armor. Match the round dark carbon-fibre helmet frame, clear curved face window, metallic green secondary visor, one rectangular white top lamp, and neck ring. Object: complete EMPTY silver flexible EVA suit of the Covenant standard type as worn by Daniels, single assembled outfit with helmet, gloves, both boots and compact life-support pack. Display upright in neutral right-facing three-quarter view without a visible mannequin, person or stand. Thin adult proportions appropriate to Daniels, no broad male physique. Base all actual garment seams, olive harness and silver wrinkled fabric on images1/3; reproduce the oval dark helmet with its metallic green outer visor lowered as image3 so it clearly contains no face. Boots and toe indicators exactly like image3 but with NO round display plinth and no hanging power cable. Entire single suit inside transparent frame with 10% margin, both soles visible.
